Spatial visionOS glass window

I wanted to know if one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas could render a 3D tilted spatial glass window with mipmapped Gaussian frost, Snell rim refraction, chromatic edge dispersion, directional bevel speculars and gaze button glow while keeping tilted HTML controls clickable with updateElementGeometry().

Show the code Mipmapped room and Gaussian blur FBOs, Snell dispersion bevel shader, 3D homography and hit geometry
  1. The live drawable spatial workspace panel. One <section id="vg-panel" drawable> holds translucent pill buttons, room chips, a range slider and an editable note input inside <canvas content="drawable" layoutsubtree>.
  2. 3D perspective projection and exact planar ray-plane unprojection. Builds matching uMvp and 3D DOMMatrix transforms plus the 3x3 inverse homography invHomography so pointer hover maps back into tilted panel coordinates.
  3. Procedural room, Gaussian frost, Snell rim dispersion and bevel specular shader. Samples mipmapped room and blur FBOs through a rounded-box SDF with R/G/B bevel dispersion, pointer-tracked rim highlights and button proximity glow before compositing premultiplied DOM UI.
  4. Offscreen FBO pipeline with explicit FBO/VAO unbind. Renders the architectural room into roomFbo with mipmaps, blurs through two separable Gaussian passes into blurFboB, and unbinds both FBO and VAO before screen compositing.
  5. Single ElementGL stage, premultiplied upload and projective hit boxes. Enables UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL on creation and restore, calls stage.begin() before stage.upload(), and updates updateElementGeometry() with geometryUnit().
  6. Five-argument drawElementImage() 2D fallback and plain HTML rescue. Draws a 2D rounded frosted slab and directional bevel when WebGL 2 is absent, or unwraps #vg-panel into #plain-host on context loss.

How it works

  • Each frame on the WebGL 2 path runs in two stages inside the one ElementGL context. First, GlassPipeline renders the procedural Studio Dawn or Passthrough Loft room into an offscreen roomFbo with generateMipmap(), runs four separable 13-tap Gaussian blur passes across two half-resolution FBOs, and finishes by calling gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null) and gl.bindVertexArray(null).
  • Next, stage.begin() sets up the screen framebuffer, uploads #vg-panel only when domDirty is set inside paint (with UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL = true), draws Pass 0 for the full-screen room and 3D perspective drop shadow, and draws Pass 1 with the 3D tilted panel matrix uMvp.
  • Inside Pass 1, sdRoundBox() masks the rounded window perimeter and calculates the curved edge normal. Snell's law bends screen UVs separately for red, green and blue around the bevel rim while sampling mipmapped room and Gaussian blur textures behind the frosted core.
  • A sharp 1 to 2 px specular rim glides around the perimeter toward uLight, paired with an opposite secondary catchlight and subtle chromatic bevel tint. Before compositing the crisp premultiplied DOM texture on top, the shader illuminates the six [data-gaze-slot] pill bounds with a radial highlight centred at the ray-unprojected pointer position uGazeLocal.
  • syncHitGeometry() passes the matching 3D perspective DOMMatrix scaled by geometryUnit() to canvas.updateElementGeometry() and toggles dataset.hitTick so every pill button, range scrubber and text input remains clickable while tilted.

Live checks

Each check builds an isolated fixture on testStage() and retires its canvas afterwards so the live window above stays untouched.

ResultExperimentDetail

Findings

Measured in headless Google Chrome 160.0.0.0 canary on 2026-11-27 at 412x915 and 2.625 DPR (SwiftShader WebGL). Chrome 157, npm run check:jank and Chrome 159 on Android stay not verified.

  • Works: mipmapped room and Gaussian blur FBOs inside one ElementGL context. Separating the room backdrop and four 13-tap Gaussian blur passes into half-res FBOs and unbinding both FBO and VAO before stage.begin() rendered at glErr=0 across 0.98 MP (7.85 MB) with 0 lost contexts, 0 open snapshots and 0 unasked readbacks.
  • Works: premultiplied translucent glass DOM and pointer-tracked bevels. Keeping UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL = true at context creation, in onRestored and in every fixture lets translucent pills blend cleanly over frosted glass. Moving uLight from top-left to bottom-right shifted 1 to 2 px rounded bevel luminance from 255.0 vs 91.3 to 145.5 vs 255.0, tilting 14°/22° shifted corner luminance by 48.5, and gaze proximity brightened the centred button slot by +131.0.
  • Works: projective updateElementGeometry() under 3D tilt. Scaling the 3D perspective DOMMatrix by geometryUnit() and toggling dataset.hitTick kept both an off-centre fixture button at 16°/-24° (3.4 px shift) and the live tilted #vg-next button clickable via elementsFromPoint().
  • Works: fallbacks and reduced motion notice. Deleting texElementSubImage2D() fell back cleanly to 5-argument drawElementImage() (0 wrong-draw-size hits), deleting drawElementImage() unwrapped #vg-panel into #plain-host with scrollWidth === innerWidth === 412, and toggling prefers-reduced-motion: reduce showed .motion-warn with working Hide stage and Show stage controls.
  • Not verified yet: real Android Chrome 159 touch interaction and GPU frame rates at 412 px and 2.625 DPR, plus npm run check:jank.
